caption: On a black stage a glowing DJ console sits at center, its two turntable tops lit green and four speaker circles outlined red. Three humanoid dancers rendered as neon outlines wear fedora hats with red glowing eyes and red-and-blue shoes, holding positions at left, center, and right. They are already mid-routine. The group performs a mirrored stepping and leaning dance. The side figures lift a knee, lean their torsos back, and swing bent arms, periodically thrusting both hands forward to point, while the center dancer gestures over the console, spreading and drawing in its arms and pointing outward. Their horizontal positions stay roughly fixed, so the movement is body choreography rather than travel across the stage. The console's outline shifts from orange-yellow to yellow-green early on. Near the end the neon outlines recolor from teal-green to purple-magenta, and two larger purple-outlined dancers appear at the far left and right edges, expanding the visible group from three to five while the console remains fixed in size and position. The routine continues.
relations: As side dancers lift knees and swing arms, the center dancer gestures over the console with fixed horizontal positions.
The console outline shifts from orange-yellow to yellow-green early, triggering the start of the color transition sequence.
Near the end, dancer neon outlines recolor from teal-green to purple-magenta, allowing two larger purple dancers to emerge.
The two new dancers appear at far edges, expanding the group to five while the console remains fixed in size.
